source_text: Ἡ ἐκκλησία τοῦ θεοῦ ἡ παροικοῦσα Ῥώμην τῆ ἐκκλησίᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ τῇ παροικούσῃ Κόρινθον, κλητοῖς ἡγιασμένοις ἐν θελήματι θεοῦ διὰ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ. χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ παντοκράτορος θεοῦ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ πληθυνθείη. Διὰ τὰς αἰφνιδίους καὶ ἐπαλλήλους γενομένας ἡμῖν συμφορὰς καὶ περιπτώσεις, βράδιον νομίζομεν ἐπιστροφὴν πεποιῆσθαι περὶ τῶν ἐπιζητουμένων παῤ ὑμῖν πραγμάτων, ἀγαπητοί, τῆς τε ἀλλοτρίας καὶ ξένης τοῖς ἐκλεκτοῖς τοῦ θεοῦ, μιαρᾶς καὶ ἀνοσίου στάσεως ἣν ὀλίγα πρόσωπα προπετῆ καὶ αὐθάδη ὑπάρχοντα εἰς τοσοῦτον ἀπονοίας ἐξέκαυσαν, ὥστε τὸ σεμνὸν καὶ περιβόητον καὶ πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις ἀξιαγάπητον ὄνομα ὑμῶν μεγάλως βλασφημηθῆναι. τίς γὰρ παρεπιδημήσας πρὸς ὑμᾶς τὴν πανάρετον καὶ βεβαίαν ὑμῶν πίστιν οὐκ ἐδοκίμασεν; τήν τε σώφρονα καὶ ἐπιεικῆ ἐν Χριστῷ εὐσέβειαν οὐκ ἐθαύμασεν; καὶ τὸ μεγαλοπρεπὲς τῆς φιλοξενίας ὑμῶν ἦθος οὐκ ἐκήρυξεν; καὶ τὴν τελείαν καὶ ἀσφαλῆ γνῶσιν οὐκ ἐμακάρισεν; ἀπροσωπολήμπτως γὰρ πάντα ἐποιεῖτε καὶ ἐν τοῖς νομίμοις τοῦ θεοῦ ἐπορεύεσθε, ὑποτασσόμενοι τοῖς ἡγουμένοις ὑμῶν, καὶ τιμὴν τὴν καθήκουσαν ἀπονέμοντες τοῖς παῤ ὑμῖν πρεσβυτέροις: νέοις τε μέτρια καὶ σεμνὰ νοεῖν ἐπετρέπετε: γυναιξίν τε ἐν ἀμώμῳ καὶ σεμνῇ καὶ ἁγνῇ συνειδήσει πάντα ἐπιτελεῖν παρηγγέλλετε, στεργούσας καθηκόντως τοὺς ἄνδρας ἑαυτῶν: ἔν τε τῷ κανόνι τῆς ὑποταγῆς ὑπαρχούσας τὰ κατὰ τὸν οἶκον σεμνῶς οἰκουργεῖν ἐδιδάσκετε, πάνυ σωφρονούσας.
pass_a_gloss: The church of God which sojourns in Rome to the church of God which sojourns in Corinth, to those called and sanctified in the will of God through our Lord Jesus Christ. Grace and peace be multiplied to you from God who is all-powerful through Jesus Christ. Because of the sudden and repeated calamities and misfortunes which have happened to us, we consider it is time to turn to the matters which are being sought by you, beloved, both the foreign and strange to the elect of God, wicked and unholy rebellion which a few headstrong and arrogant persons have stirred up to such a degree of madness, so that your honorable and renowned and to all people beloved name has been greatly blasphemed. For who has visited you and not approved your blameless and firm faith? And not marveled at your prudent and gentle in Christ piety? And not proclaimed the magnificent character of your hospitality? And not blessed your complete and secure knowledge? For you did all things without respect of persons and walked in the things that are lawful of God, submitting to your leaders and giving the honor that is due to the elders among you, and allowing the young to think moderate and honorable things, and commanding the women to do all things in blameless and honorable and pure conscience, loving their own husbands as is fitting, and teaching those in the order of submission in the household to manage the house honorably, being very prudent.

choices.why: adjective describes conscience and household management

pass_b_english: The church of God that sojourns in Rome writes to the church of God that sojourns in Corinth — to those who are called and sanctified in God's will through our Lord Jesus Christ. May grace and peace be multiplied to you from Almighty God through Jesus Christ.

Because of the sudden and repeated calamities and misfortunes that have befallen us, we consider it time to turn to the matters you have asked about, beloved. These matters are foreign and alien to God's elect: a wicked and unholy rebellion that a few headstrong and arrogant persons have fanned into such madness that your honorable, renowned, and universally beloved name has been greatly blasphemed.

For who has visited you and not approved your blameless and firm faith? Who has not marveled at your prudent and gentle piety in Christ? Who has not proclaimed the magnificent character of your hospitality? Who has not pronounced a blessing on your complete and secure knowledge?

For you did everything without partiality and walked in God's lawful ways, submitting to your leaders and giving due honor to the elders among you. You allowed the young to think moderate and honorable thoughts. You commanded the women to carry out everything with a blameless, honorable, and pure conscience, loving their own husbands as is fitting. You taught those in the order of submission to manage the household honorably, with great prudence.

review.notes: The translation accurately captures the Greek text. Pass A and Pass B are consistent with the source. Pass B's addition of 'writes to' in the first sentence is a standard stylistic expansion for the implied verb in the Greek greeting and does not alter the meaning or agency. All clauses, including the descriptions of the rebellion and the virtues of the Corinthian church, are preserved.
